## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in Dockavel.

## Validation

- [ ] `docker compose config` passes for affected profiles
- [ ] affected PHP / Node / database / service behavior was tested
- [ ] shell syntax / CLI smoke tests pass when CLI code changed
- [ ] Nginx validation passes when routing changed
- [ ] no destructive data-cleanup behavior was introduced unintentionally

## Documentation sync

For a user-facing feature, service, runtime, source preset, CLI command, configuration option, port, workflow or behavior change:

- [ ] `README.md` updated when needed
- [ ] `README.fa.md` updated when needed
- [ ] matching `AfshinEfati/dockavel-site` documentation updated
- [ ] landing page updated when the capability belongs in the product overview
- [ ] English and Persian documentation remain aligned
- [ ] sitemap updated if a new documentation route was added

If documentation changes are not required, explain why:
